# Interferon response fabricated variant 3

Broad suppression of the antiviral program was paradoxically observed. IFI6 was downregulated in treated cells (Table 1). ISG15 was decreased (Table 1). MX1 was reduced (Table 1). OAS1 was downregulated (Table 1). TNF was elevated (Table 1). STAT1 was downregulated (Table 1).
